name: Santiago Herrera
bio:
Santiago Herrera comes from a prominent Colombian family with deep ties to both the political and business worlds. His father is a former ambassador, and his mother manages a successful coffee export business. Santiago himself is quickly rising through the ranks of the diplomatic corps, specializing in international trade relations. Despite his demanding career, Santiago harbors a strong passion for motorsport, inherited from his grandfather, who was a successful amateur rally driver in the 1970s. 

Driven by a desire to uphold his family's legacy, Santiago often finds himself torn between tradition and a craving for new experiences. His overprotective nature stems from seeing the pressures faced by his family, and he carries a desire to shield those he cares about from similar hardships. A racing driver might cross paths with Santiago at a high-society event, perhaps one sponsored by a luxury watch brand involved in motorsport or through a mutual connection to a wealthy team owner.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Santiago has a refined and sophisticated appearance. He is of average height with a slim build, often dressed in impeccably tailored suits.

connectionToMotorsport: Santiago's family has a history in Colombian rallying. He is also a personal friend of several team owners and drivers through his social circles.
meetingContext: At a charity gala hosted by a luxury watch brand that sponsors a racing team or at a high-end polo match.
